expr: (let len := lst.length; let validPeaks := List.range len |>.filter (fun p => 1 ≤ p ∧ p < len - 1 ∧ (List.range p).all (fun i => lst[i]! < lst[i + 1]!) ∧ (List.range (len - 1 - p)).all (fun i => lst[p + i]! > lst[p + i + 1]!)); validPeaks != [])

lemmas.name: peak_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (lst : List Int) (h : isPeakValley_precond lst), isPeakValley_postcond lst (let len := lst.length; let validPeaks := List.range len |>.filter (fun p => 1 ≤ p ∧ p < len - 1 ∧ (List.range p).all (fun i => lst[i]! < lst[i + 1]!) ∧ (List.range (len - 1 - p)).all (fun i => lst[p + i]! > lst[p + i + 1]!)); validPeaks != []) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro lst h
  unfold isPeakValley_postcond
  intro len validPeaks
  refine ⟨fun hb => hb, fun hl hb => ?_⟩
  have hb' : (validPeaks != []) = true := hb
  have h0 := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hl
  rw [h0] at hb'
  simp at hb'
